items.quote: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.
items.claim: The text says an inventory (the 'sum') of the tabernacle of testimony was counted at Moses' command, for the Levites' service, and carried out under Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.
items.actor: Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest
items.mechanism: according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites
